top_signals.title: Mexico Is Hopeful to Reach Deal to Lower US Tariffs This Year
top_signals.summary: Mexico Ambassador to the United States Roberto Lazzeri discusses trade talks between the US and Mexico, saying the two sides are “pretty much aligned with the overall objective.” He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
